audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level chart read "Skill" on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Skill, Naafiri, Naafiri, Naafiri, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri.
audit.why: Two layers rendering different answers to "who wins Level 2" on the same page. Naafiri genuinely owns levels 2-5 (49.52% Ahri win rate over 6934 games, and her all-in exists before your charm does), and Ahri owns everything from Spirit Rush onward.
audit.corrected: phases[1..3].side set to Naafiri and phases[4..6].side set to Ahri, matching win[] exactly; ratings on her rows dropped to 4/10 so the numbers agree with the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named her dash chain "Pack Your Bags", which is not an ability in her kit, and the packet flags that the matchup never names a single Naafiri ability.
audit.why: Her dash is Eviscerate (E), 450 range, 11/10/9/8/7 seconds. The Call of the Pack (W) is 26/24/22/20/18 and Hounds' Pursuit (R) is 110/95/80. Those three numbers are the whole spike schedule and none of them appeared.
audit.corrected: Spikes rebuilt on Eviscerate, The Call of the Pack and Hounds' Pursuit with their real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Charm instantly stops movement abilities, so it freezes Eviscerate and Hounds' Pursuit mid-dash — and The Call of the Pack's untargetability is the one thing that beats it.
audit.why: Ahri's E text says it instantly stops movement abilities. Naafiri's E and R are both dashes, so a landed charm ends her commit outright. Her W explicitly makes her Untargetable, which means a charm thrown into it is simply spent for nothing — that is the wait-it-out window, and it is 26s at rank 1 falling to 18s.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[3], whys[2], whys[5], breakdown.carry and dontsFull[0].d: charm stops the dash, but never throw it into The Call of the Pack.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advised "Add anti-heal early into his sustain".
audit.why: Riot's Eviscerate text says it recalls her packmates and fully heals THEM — it is not champion self-sustain. The needs-antiheal flag in the derived data contradicts the description, and per the brief's own rule the description wins. Buying Grievous Wounds as the answer to Naafiri's dive is the wrong item on the wrong problem.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Zhonya's, which actually answers a lock-on dash commit.
sources: enemyKit E text vs derived heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri was written as "his"/"him" across the full layer.
audit.why: Wrong-gender pronouns are the signature of copy pasted from another matchup, and a reader spots it immediately.
audit.corrected: Corrected in winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull, dontsFull and the matching report entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: The punishable-cooldown section named only Hounds' Pursuit.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit is 110s at rank 1, so it is not the lane's rhythm — Eviscerate at 11s is the cooldown you actually schedule around, and The Call of the Pack at 26s is the one that eats your charm.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around all three numbers.

notes: "Pack Your Bags" is not a Naafiri ability — her dash is Eviscerate (E). The packet's defect line was accurate: not one of her five abilities was named anywhere in the matchup before this pass. Level chart disagreed between layers on all six non-Level-1 rows; fixed as one atomic group. Derived-flag conflict recorded rather than asserted: Eviscerate carries a heal flag, but Riot's text says it fully heals her PACKMATES, not Naafiri, so the anti-heal advice was removed rather than restated. Left alone because the kit cannot answer it: whether Charm is cleansable or tenacity-reduced, and whether Eviscerate and Hounds' Pursuit actually grant untargetability during the dash (the derived flags claim it; Riot's text only says it for The Call of the Pack). | COHERENCE: 2 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
